messages:
maya: proposing a small left-nav regroup: move Models beside Deployments and fold Monitoring under Observability. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/console-nav
kevin: ok, but permalink stability? our docs reference /models/:id now.
olivia: keep breadcrumbs showing resource hierarchy (Project > Models > Model > Version) regardless of left-nav grouping.
samir: strong preference for path-based canonical URLs (no hashes). examples: /p/:projectId/models/:modelId/versions/:versionId and /p/:projectId/deployments/:deploymentId. UI-only state via query params like ?side=collapsed
jordan: a11y: when deep-linking, focus should land on main heading. add aria-current on active nav items and a visible skip link.
a11y-bot: checklist: 1) aria-current present 2) skip-to-main 3) focus management on load 4) descriptive link text 5) keyboard nav tests
kevin: plan: add middleware that maps legacy /models/:id to new /p/:projectId/models/:modelId with 301 redirects for 12 months.
maya: draft decision: 1) adopt path-based canonical routes 2) UI state in query params 3) 12-month redirects for legacy shapes 4) breadcrumbs reflect logical hierarchy
olivia: UX nicety: show a transient banner when arriving via external deep link: "You're viewing Model X via direct link" with an "Open navigation" button to help orientation.
samir: router needs routeAliases to support canary rollouts and fallback shapes.
maya: owners: kevin -> middleware & redirects, jordan -> a11y checklist/tests, olivia -> banner microcopy, i'll update Figma and write short RFC. will post RFC EOD.
